title: Finite rational comparison for a specified exceptional system
statement: For any specified source and target Realizations and specified exceptional coefficient System S, fix native geometry, a compactification c and one finite coefficient subfield E. Let a be a completed-to-native coefficient change agreeing with every normalized CoefficientPresentation.integralMap. If l is invertible in all residue fields of X, there is a unique natural isomorphism between inclusion E followed by S.closed and target.J, and inclusion E followed by source.J and actual c, whose components on integral representatives equal the explicitly constructed systemIntegralMap. That map is the faithful lift of the actual proper/open scalar mate between the specified boundary comparisons. No field-transition equality or common-stage descent is asserted.

proof.text: Identify the specified finite rational operation using the inverse commonComparison followed by rationalLeft. The raw integral localization commutes with the finite compact-support action by the pure-tensor map formula. Compose with the target integral realization and inverse completed compact-support realization to obtain systemIntegralSource. The source integral realization and native operationTransport give systemIntegralTarget.

proof.text: Conjugate the genuine proper/open comparison a by these boundaries and lift the resulting natural transformation uniquely along the fully faithful section equivalence. For each integral constructible K, residue Tor identifies the same underlying object with a finite-Tor input. The native scalar-mate theorem makes the middle component invertible. Its boundary conjugate is invertible, and sections reflect isomorphisms.
